question: What is the registrant's telephone number?
rationale: Inspected page 1 of all 10 10-K cover pages and observed two layout variants: (a) docs where the 'Registrant's telephone number...' label span carries the phone inline (AMCOR, COSTCO, BOEING, EBAY, J&J) and (b) docs where the phone lives in a separate adjacent span (CORNING, NIKE, LOCKHEED) or embedded in the address span (AMAZON 2016/2018). A single rule restricted to page 1 and selecting spans that either contain the substring 'telephone' or match a US/international phone-number regex covers all 10 docs. Match rate = 1.0 with sum_avg_cost_ratio = 0.000332 — all three soft targets comfortably met, so no further rule was needed.
